correctness.rationale: Conditional on count n, n uniform points on [0,t] give Dirichlet(1,...,1) normalized n+1 gaps, including the right censored last gap; integrate the exact inclusion-exclusion tail to get E[L|N=n]=t H_{n+1}/(n+1) even at n=0. The harmonic exponential generating function e^μ Ein(μ) yields E[L]=t Ein(μ)/μ. Poisson score identity Cov(N,g(N))=μ d/dμ E[g(N)] gives t/μ[1-e^{-μ}-Ein(μ)]. Its negative sign follows from derivative of Ein(μ)-1+e^{-μ} being [1-(1+μ)e^{-μ}]/μ>0. Independent 90-term direct Poisson mixture at μ=3,t=2 computed covariance -0.4924422686878027 versus analytic -0.49244226868780216; checked both small μ -λt²/4 and large μ -(log μ+γ-1)/λ. Correct only for homogeneous Poisson fixed window including both endpoint gaps.

value.rationale: Count and maximal idle gap are canonical observables of the same Poisson process; their exact negative covariance (all intensities and windows) measures a meaningful dependence absent from the known separate marginal formulas. The derivation is short but the joint statistic and sign are independently useful, with modest rather than paper-sized mathematical scope.

final_claim: For a rate-λ homogeneous Poisson process on [0,t] with both boundary gaps, Cov(N(t),L_t)=t[1-e^{-μ}-Ein(μ)]/μ<0 where μ=λt, with sharp small/large μ asymptotics.
limitations: Homogeneous Poisson and terminal censored gap included; not inhomogeneous processes or the completed-gap-only statistic.
